summary: Presents a mechanism for an ALTO server to push incremental updates to clients using Server-Sent Events, so clients need not re-fetch full network information resources. ALTO provides network-related information that helps applications make better decisions. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: A program asking the network for advice would normally have to keep asking again. With this, the advisor sends only the changes whenever something changes, which saves a lot of repeated asking.

questions: how does alto send incremental updates
